name: Golf Saudi
note: Organiser of the PIF Global Series (pifglobalseries.com footer, fetched 25 Sep 2026); the series is 'Golf Saudi's series of elite events on the Ladies European Tour' (pifglobalseries.com homepage). Golf Saudi describes itself as delivering a national golf development programme under Saudi Vision 2030 (golfsaudi.com/en/this_is_golf_saudi, fetched 25 Sep 2026) but publishes no ownership statement; left unowned rather than guessed.
